name: 去AI味
examples_zh: 把这段AI生成的文章改得更自然
去掉这段文字里明显的AI写作痕迹
用口语化的方式重写这段内容
测一下这篇稿子的AI味指数
把这份工作汇报改写得像人写的
examples_en: Rewrite this AI-generated text to sound more human
Remove the robotic tone from this paragraph
Make this content sound more conversational
Score this article for AI writing tells
description_zh: 去 AI 味 / 人话化：检测并去除中英文文本中的 AI 写作痕迹，输出 0-100 量化评分 + 改写稿 + 复评。覆盖中文官腔八股、互联网黑话、模板口水、结尾升华、模糊归因、伪深度，以及英文 Wikipedia:Signs of AI writing 的 24 种模式。含纯 stdlib 扫描脚本，支持单文件、管道、批量。
description_en: Humanizer: detect and remove AI writing tells in Chinese and English text, with a 0-100 score, rewrite, and re-score. Covers Chinese officialese, internet buzzwords, template phrasing, grandiose endings, vague attribution, fake depth, plus Wikipedia's 24 signs of AI writing. Bundles a pure-stdlib scanner with file, pipe, and batch support.
